description.value: Punjab Food Center is a South Asian grocery supermarket on Main Street in Vancouver, offering a wide array of consumer products including many unique and hard-to-find items. The business operates both a physical storefront and an online ordering platform. It sits on a major arterial corridor through South Vancouver, making it a convenient resupply stop for cyclists passing through the neighbourhood.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the physical address (6635 Main St, Vancouver, BC V5X 3H3) and provides a phone number (604) 322 5502 not in OSM. The site describes Punjab Food Center as 'an online fulfillment center' with a wide array of consumer products, and the profile page lists grocery categories (meat, produce, bakeries, etc.), supporting the OSM supermarket tag. No cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, water, washrooms) are mentioned anywhere on the site.
concerns: OSM has no phone number; (604) 322-5502 sourced from website contact page only.

Website describes the business as 'an online fulfillment center,' which introduces mild ambiguity about walk-in retail availability, though the confirmed physical address and supermarket OSM tag suggest a physical store exists.
Website profile page content appears to be generic industry boilerplate rather than original business description, suggesting the site may not be actively maintained.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, publicly accessible grocery supermarket at a confirmed physical address on a major Vancouver cycling corridor. Website is active and contact details are consistent with OSM.

wow_evidence: South Asian grocery supermarket on Main Street in Vancouver
